description: Truthful cloud-operations manifest for ST Production House autonomous workflows. Each entry lists the workflow file and the EXTERNAL secrets it requires, as verified from the workflow's own secrets usage. The runner-provided GITHUB_TOKEN is intentionally not listed. The scheduled self-audit classifies each workflow RUNNABLE (all required external secrets configured) or PAUSED (missing credentials) and never fabricates availability (AGENTS.md Rules 1-3).

workflows.description: Scheduled truthful self-audit classifying every autonomous workflow as RUNNABLE or PAUSED (missing credentials) and uploading the report as a run artifact.
